MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 611 December 18, 1974
RATIFYING THE EMPLOYMENT POLICY CONVENTION, 1964, ADOPTED BY THE
INTERNATIONAL LABOUR ORGANIZATION
I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the
Constitution, do hereby decree and order that the Employment Policy Convention, 1964 (Convention No.
122), adopted by the International Labour Organization on July 9, 1964, at its Forty-eight session held at
Geneva, Switzerland, shall be, as it is, hereby ratified.
Let a copy of this Decree be transmitted to the Director-General, International Labor Office pursuant to its
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
